title: Glassdoor Reviews Scraper
description: Provide Glassdoor company reviews-page URLs (recommended) or company names. Anonymous runs scrape public page-1 reviews; add Glassdoor cookies for authenticated pagination.

companyUrls.title: Company Glassdoor URLs
companyUrls.description: Glassdoor company reviews page URLs, e.g. https://www.glassdoor.com/Reviews/Google-Reviews-E9079.htm

companyNames.title: Company Names
companyNames.description: Company names to search on Glassdoor. Direct URLs are more reliable than names.

maxReviewsPerCompany.title: Max Reviews Per Company
maxReviewsPerCompany.description: Maximum reviews to scrape per company. Anonymous runs are limited to public page-1 reviews; authenticated cookie runs can paginate deeper.

glassdoorCookies.title: Glassdoor Cookies
glassdoorCookies.description: Optional authenticated Glassdoor cookies. Paste either a browser Cookie header (name=value; name2=value2) or a JSON cookie array. Required for page 2+ pagination.

filterByEmploymentStatus.title: Filter by Employment Status
filterByEmploymentStatus.description: Only keep reviews from employees with this status.

filterByJobTitle.title: Filter by Job Title
filterByJobTitle.description: Only keep reviews whose job title contains this text (case-insensitive). Leave empty for all.

filterByLocation.title: Filter by Location
filterByLocation.description: Only keep reviews whose location contains this text (case-insensitive). Leave empty for all.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Glassdoor uses Cloudflare protection, so residential proxies are strongly recommended.
